symptom: Container instance shows status=ACTIVE but agentConnected=false. New tasks aren't placed; running tasks continue but state-changes aren't reported. ECS event log: 'service X has stopped Y running tasks: Task failed ELB health checks'.

diagnostic_steps.action: Confirm agent is running on the instance
diagnostic_steps.command: ssh ec2-user@<instance>; sudo systemctl status ecs

diagnostic_steps.action: Check agent logs for ACS WebSocket failures
diagnostic_steps.expected: ACS reconnect attempts; underlying error (DNS, TLS handshake, throttled)

diagnostic_steps.action: Verify NAT/internet egress to ECS service endpoint

diagnostic_steps.command: aws sts get-caller-identity; check that role has AmazonEC2ContainerServiceforEC2Role policy
diagnostic_steps.expected: Role + ecs:RegisterContainerInstance, ecs:DiscoverPollEndpoint, ecs:Poll, ecs:UpdateContainerInstancesState perms

fix_steps.action: If chronic, check security group / NACL for egress 443 to ecs.<region>.amazonaws.com
fix_steps.command: Inspect SG outbound rules + NACL; add 443 → 0.0.0.0/0 if missing

symptom: Agent process killed by OOM killer on instance running many high-density tasks. dmesg shows 'Out of memory: Killed process <pid> (agent)'. Tasks orphaned (still running but no agent control).

diagnostic_steps.action: Confirm OOM kill of agent specifically
diagnostic_steps.command: sudo dmesg | grep -i 'killed process' | grep -i agent

diagnostic_steps.expected: Should be high enough to cover agent + system overhead (typically 256-512 MiB on dense instances)

fix_steps.action: Raise ECS_RESERVED_MEMORY to subtract more from advertised capacity (forces fewer tasks)
fix_steps.command: echo 'ECS_RESERVED_MEMORY=512' | sudo tee -a /etc/ecs/ecs.config; sudo systemctl restart ecs
fix_steps.validation: Tasks placed less densely; OOM stops

fix_steps.action: Set agent container memory limit explicitly via systemd
fix_steps.validation: Agent OOMs gracefully (won't be killed first)

symptom: Tasks fail to launch on cgroup v2 instances; CannotCreateContainerError mentions cgroup-v2 mount or hierarchy issues. Particularly with older agent versions.

fix_steps.action: Upgrade agent (in-place or via AMI rotation)
fix_steps.command: Trigger ECS-managed update OR use AL2023 ECS-Optimized AMI (ships current agent + cgroup-v2 ready)

fix_steps.action: If can't upgrade, fall back to cgroup v1
fix_steps.command: Add systemd.unified_cgroup_hierarchy=0 to host kernel cmdline; reboot

symptom: Container instance set to DRAINING but tasks aren't being replaced. Tasks stuck in RUNNING on the draining instance. Service event log shows no new task placements.

diagnostic_steps.expected: Pending count >0 and events show 'unable to place task'
Sum of remainingResources should fit a task; if not, no capacity

fix_steps.action: Add capacity (scale up ASG or add an instance manually)
fix_steps.command: Increase ASG desiredCapacity OR run-instances manually
fix_steps.validation: New instance ACTIVE; service places replacement tasks
fix_steps.rollback: Scale back down once draining completes

fix_steps.action: If using capacity providers, raise managedScaling targetCapacity / instanceWarmupPeriod
fix_steps.command: Update CP managedScaling.targetCapacity to <100 (e.g. 80) so cluster keeps slack
fix_steps.validation: Auto-scaling provisions new instance for replacement

symptom: agent log: 'failed to dial docker: Get "http://%2Fvar%2Frun%2Fdocker.sock": EOF'. Docker daemon isn't reachable.

diagnostic_steps.command: sudo systemctl status docker; sudo journalctl -u docker --since '10min ago' | tail -50

diagnostic_steps.expected: srw-rw---- root:docker; agent uid in docker group

fix_steps.command: sudo systemctl restart docker; sudo systemctl restart ecs

fix_steps.action: If Docker repeatedly fails, check disk space (Docker writes to /var/lib/docker)

symptom: Task fails with CannotPullContainerError 'image not found' RIGHT after a previous task using the same image successfully completed and was cleaned up. Image was deleted by agent's cleanup right as the new task tried to use it.

fix_steps.command: echo 'ECS_IMAGE_MINIMUM_CLEANUP_AGE=24h' | sudo tee -a /etc/ecs/ecs.config; sudo systemctl restart ecs

fix_steps.action: Or set ECS_IMAGE_PULL_BEHAVIOR=always so tasks re-pull regardless of cache state
fix_steps.command: echo 'ECS_IMAGE_PULL_BEHAVIOR=always' | sudo tee -a /etc/ecs/ecs.config; sudo systemctl restart ecs
fix_steps.validation: Tasks always pull (slower start, no cache races)

symptom: Task fails immediately with 'Unable to assume the role' or 'access denied' on first call to AWS API, even though task IAM role exists. Race: task starts before IAM role's trust relationship has propagated.

diagnostic_steps.action: Check task execution role + task role exist and are recent
diagnostic_steps.expected: Role created >30s ago for IAM consistency
Trust policy allows ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com to assume

fix_steps.action: Add 30-60s delay between IAM role creation and task launch in CI/CD
Or implement retry-with-backoff on the task side
fix_steps.command: App code wraps first AWS API call in retry loop

symptom: Spot-backed instance terminated mid-task. Tasks were running but no draining happened; service has to scramble to replace them. Disrupts in-flight work.

fix_steps.command: echo 'ECS_ENABLE_SPOT_INSTANCE_DRAINING=true' | sudo tee -a /etc/ecs/ecs.config; sudo systemctl restart ecs
fix_steps.validation: Future spot interruptions trigger DRAINING; tasks gracefully replaced

fix_steps.command: Add line to user-data so newly launched instances always have it

symptom: Agent restart re-discovers running tasks but takes a long time. agent log: 'state file not found'. Symptom: brief task-status flapping in console.

fix_steps.action: Ensure ECS_HOST_DATA_DIR + ECS_DATADIR set + bind mount present
